blue_regular.instructions: Your goal is to make sure the blue team wins by enacting blue policies.

red_regular.instructions: Your goal is to make sure the red team wins by enacting red policies, or by electing the red leader as policy maker once at least 3 red policies have been enacted.
red_regular.private_information: Your team members are players {red_players} and your team leader is {red_leader}. The leader does not know who's in the red team.

red_leader.instructions: Your goal is to make sure the red team wins by enacting red policies, or by getting yourself elected as policy maker once at least 3 red policies have been enacted.
